title: Lizzie Miles and racial attitudes in 1940s New Orleans
summary: They discuss Lizzie Miles with an all-white band, how black performers dealt with segregation, and her anger over the library not admitting her.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand
